posts.title: Usable seL4 on RISC-V: QSOE/L vs Sculpt
posts.description: I wanted to know which seL4-based systems on RISC-V you can actually use as a workstation — compile code, keep files on a real disk, run a shell — rather than flash once and leave running. So I put the question to Google's AI Mode. It came back with a comparison of two: QSOE/L and Sculpt OS running on seL4. The structure was sound; several of the details were wrong. posts.title: I Wanted to Build QSOE 0.4 on Azure Linux 4.0 -- Here's What Happened
posts.description: QSOE is built every day on Debian.
